# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release (`v1.2.x`) and the `main` branch receive fixes.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `1.2.x` | Yes |
| `< 1.2` | No |

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security issues in public issues or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/srm-speed-torque-control/security/advisories/new) or email `andrew.abdelmalak3@gmail.com`.

Include:

- The affected commit or version
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- The expected impact
